headline: AI Chip Substrate Demand Surges! Analysts Bullish on Four Taiwanese ABF Substrate Makers' Operational Momentum
summary: Analysts expect AI chip applications to account for 52% of ABF substrate demand by area by 2027, up from 35% in 2025. They say AI has become the main driver of ABF substrate demand growth.
why: ABF substrates are advanced packaging materials used in high-end chips, so their demand reflects the AI hardware build-out. Taiwan is a major hub for these component makers.
